crossing: first complete target-pair iteration at or above each charged node-work label

decision.inconclusive: all other complete outcomes; zero-collision structural stop is inconclusive strength
decision.negative: any new candidate absolute gate fails or known or any new candidate worsens >0.001
decision.positive: all three new candidate absolute gates pass; known mechanistic improves >=0.001; at least one new medium improves >=0.001; other new medium worsens <=0.001; low/wet worsens <=0.001

novelty_rule: exclude every existing or selected (sorted flop ranks, turn rank) signature regardless of suits; no tree/collision/policy/score/reference/runtime selection
path_order: for each spot in path_spots: unchanged q8 control then exact-turn candidate
primary_metric: final linear-average exact restricted-game NashConv/2 in chips and fraction initial pot, lower better

profile.T: maximum fixed-worker sum of path maxima
profile.clock: context through capture, own scoring and replay

publication: prospective protocol before selection; selection source before cohort freeze; frozen cohort before tree/collision/outcome; qualified source before proof; proof before profile; profile and separate admission before own; own before reference; final exact-source checks
question: exact acting turn and river information versus unchanged q8 turn and exact river under matched full expected work
random_generator: PCG64 state unchanged in both full expected paths
report: all four paired spot differences at each work label, no seed-based confidence interval
recall, exact/abstract rows, table bytes, actual work and overshoot
wall time, hardware and peak RSS
control-final top three turn/river additive gain rows and same rows both arms/checkpoints with cards/actions/policy/reach/values
turn collision inventory for all four spots

shared_training.traversal: full expected, all tree nodes charged including zero reach

structural_stop: if all three new inputs have zero turn collisions after source qualification, stop before training without replacements
